title: Classify Character Type

content.problemStatement: Check whether the given character is an alphabet or a number or special character

solution.approach: Classify character as ALPHABET, NUMBER, or SPECIAL CHARACTER.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Check if character is digit (0-9) -> NUMBER, letter (a-z, A-Z) -> ALPHABET, else -> SPECIAL CHARACTER.

hints: Use isdigit() or check '0' <= c <= '9' for NUMBER.
